sproutle.name: Sproutle
sproutle.dexText: A seed sprouts on its back. It naps in sunbeams to grow.

thornvale.name: Thornvale
thornvale.dexText: Its thorny vines snap out to guard the forest edge.

verdanox.name: Verdanox
verdanox.dexText: Ancient groves grow where it sleeps through the winter.

cindercub.name: Cindercub
cindercub.dexText: Its tail tip glows like an ember. It is warm to hug.

pyrolynx.name: Pyrolynx
pyrolynx.dexText: It spars with boulders, kicking sparks into the air.

infernox.name: Infernox
infernox.dexText: Flames wreath its fists. It never backs down from a duel.

ripplet.name: Ripplet
ripplet.dexText: It splashes in tide pools and sleeps under wet sand.

tidalisk.name: Tidalisk
tidalisk.dexText: It digs burrows along riverbanks with its broad tail.

abyssaur.name: Abyssaur
abyssaur.dexText: It can heave a boat ashore. Its roar churns the sea.

nibbit.name: Nibbit
nibbit.dexText: It nibbles anything. Its front teeth never stop growing.

gnawlord.name: Gnawlord
gnawlord.dexText: It gnaws through logs in seconds to build its dens.

chirpling.name: Chirpling
chirpling.dexText: Flocks of them chatter in the treetops at dawn.

gustrel.name: Gustrel
gustrel.dexText: It rides updrafts for hours without flapping once.

wrigglet.name: Wrigglet
wrigglet.dexText: It munches leaves all day and spins silk at night.

cocoonix.name: Cocoonix
cocoonix.dexText: It hangs from branches in a silk shell, waiting.

lumoth.name: Lumoth
lumoth.dexText: Its wings scatter glowing scales on moonlit nights.

voltick.name: Voltick
voltick.dexText: Static builds in its fur. It crackles when petted.

amperix.name: Amperix
amperix.dexText: It dashes like lightning, leaving scorched grass behind.

pebblin.name: Pebblin
pebblin.dexText: Hikers trip over it, mistaking it for a plain rock.

bouldron.name: Bouldron
bouldron.dexText: It rolls down mountainsides, flattening all in its path.

mossling.name: Mossling
mossling.dexText: Spores puff from its cap whenever it is startled.

fungloom.name: Fungloom
fungloom.dexText: Its drifting spore clouds can lull a whole meadow to sleep.

shadepup.name: Shadepup
shadepup.dexText: It tails travelers at dusk, growling at their heels.

duskhound.name: Duskhound
duskhound.dexText: Packs hunt in silence under a moonless sky.

duskwisp.name: Duskwisp
duskwisp.dexText: A flickering light in old woods. It giggles at lost hikers.

frostkit.name: Frostkit
frostkit.dexText: Snow never melts on its fluffy coat, even in summer.

psyowl.name: Psyowl
psyowl.dexText: It sees glimpses of tomorrow in its dreams.

ironmite.name: Ironmite
ironmite.dexText: Its steel shell rings like a bell when struck.

glimmerfin.name: Glimmerfin
glimmerfin.dexText: Its scales flash in the shallows like scattered coins.

drakelet.name: Drakelet
drakelet.dexText: It dreams of flying, leaping off cliffs to practice.

acornip.name: Acornip
acornip.dexText: It rolls downhill to travel and plants itself to nap.

barkhide.name: Barkhide
barkhide.dexText: Its back is armored in thick bark that shrugs off claws.

elderoak.name: Elderoak
elderoak.dexText: Stone roots bind it to hillsides it has guarded for ages.

crawlet.name: Crawlet
crawlet.dexText: It munches clover all day and hides from birds under leaves.

encasa.name: Encasa
encasa.dexText: Its silk case glows faintly as wings form inside.

brightwing.name: Brightwing
brightwing.dexText: Its wing scales flash like sunlight on water at dawn.

burrbun.name: Burrbun
burrbun.dexText: Burrs cling to its fur, so it spreads seeds as it hops.

bounder.name: Bounder
bounder.dexText: One kick of its hind legs can clear a farm fence.

cobblet.name: Cobblet
cobblet.dexText: It sits among path stones and trips careless travelers.

cragmaw.name: Cragmaw
cragmaw.dexText: Its stone jaws grind boulders into gravel for its nest.

brookit.name: Brookit
brookit.dexText: It floats on its back in streams, cracking shells on its belly.

cascadon.name: Cascadon
cascadon.dexText: It rides waterfalls downstream and leaps back up for fun.

cuffling.name: Cuffling
cuffling.dexText: It punches tree stumps every morning to toughen its paws.

anvilfist.name: Anvilfist
anvilfist.dexText: Its iron fists ring like a smithy when it trains at night.

fizzlit.name: Fizzlit
fizzlit.dexText: Static builds in its fur as it darts through dry grass.

arcferret.name: Arcferret
arcferret.dexText: It weaves between foes so fast it leaves arcs of light.

fenspawn.name: Fenspawn
fenspawn.dexText: It lurks in stagnant ponds, its skin slick with toxic slime.

bogmonarch.name: Bogmonarch
bogmonarch.dexText: It rules the marsh from a throne of rotting reeds.

flintail.name: Flintail
flintail.dexText: It strikes its tail on stones to throw sparks and light fires.

forgecrest.name: Forgecrest
forgecrest.dexText: Its scales are tempered in its own flame until they ring.

dewsprig.name: Dewsprig
dewsprig.dexText: Morning dew beads on the ferns that sprout from its back.

fernhart.name: Fernhart
fernhart.dexText: Wherever it grazes, the meadow grows back twice as thick.

antlit.name: Antlit
antlit.dexText: It can lift fifty times its weight and marches in long lines.

antlegion.name: Antlegion
antlegion.dexText: It drills its colony like soldiers and leads every charge.

eddykin.name: Eddykin
eddykin.dexText: It spins in river eddies to catch drifting bugs.

driftail.name: Driftail
driftail.dexText: Its long tail lets it ride currents for days without rest.

floodfang.name: Floodfang
floodfang.dexText: It hunts in swollen rivers after storms, jaws agape.

finchet.name: Finchet
finchet.dexText: Flocks of them chatter in hedges and squabble over seeds.

dartwing.name: Dartwing
dartwing.dexText: It zips low over fields, snatching bugs mid-flight.

falcrest.name: Falcrest
falcrest.dexText: It dives from the clouds faster than a falling stone.

cairnlet.name: Cairnlet
cairnlet.dexText: A stack of pebbles that hums softly when travelers pass.

cairnox.name: Cairnox
cairnox.dexText: Its floating stones mark the safe paths over mountain passes.

buzzlet.name: Buzzlet
buzzlet.dexText: It nibbles power lines and buzzes with stray current.

dynamoth.name: Dynamoth
dynamoth.dexText: Its wings crackle as it flits toward any glowing lamp.

fulgorax.name: Fulgorax
fulgorax.dexText: Swarms of them light up storm clouds over the plains.

delvole.name: Delvole
delvole.dexText: It tunnels under gardens and pops up to sniff the air.

excavore.name: Excavore
excavore.dexText: Its spade claws carve tunnels through solid clay in minutes.

blightcap.name: Blightcap
blightcap.dexText: It sprouts on fallen logs and puffs spores when stepped on.

dreadspore.name: Dreadspore
dreadspore.dexText: Nothing grows where its violet spore clouds settle.

bruisant.name: Bruisant
bruisant.dexText: This hermit of the woods wrestles bears to stay sharp.

arclure.name: Arclure
arclure.dexText: The glowing lure on its head draws fish into a fatal shock.

aerolith.name: Aerolith
aerolith.dexText: Said to be a meteor that learned to fly. It nests on cliffs.

joltpup.name: Joltpup
joltpup.dexText: Its fur crackles when it wags. It chases storms for fun.

joltfang.name: Joltfang
joltfang.dexText: Metal plates grow on its back to channel stray current.

kiloclaw.name: Kiloclaw
kiloclaw.dexText: Its steel claws spark on stone, lighting up the night.

kindlet.name: Kindlet
kindlet.dexText: It nests in warm chimneys and chirps sparks at dawn.

hearthawk.name: Hearthawk
hearthawk.dexText: It dives from high thermals trailing a ribbon of flame.

lavalug.name: Lavalug
lavalug.dexText: It oozes slowly over cooling lava, leaving a glowing trail.

lavalith.name: Lavalith
lavalith.dexText: Its crust hardens into stone, but magma churns beneath.

icefin.name: Icefin
icefin.dexText: It swims in cold springs. Frost forms on its fins.

glacifin.name: Glacifin
glacifin.dexText: Icy spines on its back shatter thin ice as it surfaces.

hoarwhal.name: Hoarwhal
hoarwhal.dexText: Its spout freezes midair and falls as gentle snow.

jabcrab.name: Jabcrab
jabcrab.dexText: It shadowboxes with its claws while the tide is out.

lobsmash.name: Lobsmash
lobsmash.dexText: One punch from its heavy claw can crack a ship hull.

hoglet.name: Hoglet
hoglet.dexText: It roots through fields for acorns and naps in mud.

hogburr.name: Hogburr
hogburr.dexText: Burrs cling to its bristly coat. It charges at strangers.

hogrumble.name: Hogrumble
hogrumble.dexText: The ground shakes when a herd of them stampedes past.

kittuft.name: Kittuft
kittuft.dexText: The tuft on its head twitches when it spots prey.

kingmane.name: Kingmane
kingmane.dexText: It rules the plains with a stare. Its roar silences birds.

grimlet.name: Grimlet
grimlet.dexText: It hides in old wells and giggles at passing travelers.

grimveil.name: Grimveil
grimveil.dexText: It drapes itself in mist to sneak up on the unwary.

grimwraith.name: Grimwraith
grimwraith.dexText: Its wail chills the bones. Lanterns gutter as it passes.

hushgrub.name: Hushgrub
hushgrub.dexText: It hums softly while it sleeps, lulling foes to rest.

lullamoth.name: Lullamoth
lullamoth.dexText: Dust from its wings brings sweet dreams to whole towns.

lurkit.name: Lurkit
lurkit.dexText: It sneaks into camps at night to steal shiny trinkets.

larcenox.name: Larcenox
larcenox.dexText: It hoards stolen treasure in a den no one has found.

gorsling.name: Gorsling
gorsling.dexText: Its prickly back blooms with yellow flowers in spring.

gorsebrier.name: Gorsebrier
gorsebrier.dexText: Its thorns drip with sap that numbs anyone who brushes by.

glowgnat.name: Glowgnat
glowgnat.dexText: Swarms of them flicker over ponds on summer nights.

galvanfly.name: Galvanfly
galvanfly.dexText: Its wings buzz so fast they build up a static charge.

loamole.name: Loamole
loamole.dexText: It tunnels under farms, leaving soft rows of turned soil.

loamdrill.name: Loamdrill
loamdrill.dexText: Its spiral horn bores through bedrock like soft clay.

lithwyrm.name: Lithwyrm
lithwyrm.dexText: It coils in canyon cracks and sheds skin like slate.

hexapede.name: Hexapede
hexapede.dexText: It skitters under logs on dozens of tiny, venomous legs.

larkling.name: Larkling
larkling.dexText: Its bright morning song can be heard across the valley.

larkspire.name: Larkspire
larkspire.dexText: It spirals so high it vanishes into the clouds.

jellip.name: Jellip
jellip.dexText: A wobbly blob that quivers in damp marsh grass.

jellicrown.name: Jellicrown
jellicrown.dexText: A crown of hardened gel marks it as ruler of the bog.

kragshell.name: Kragshell
kragshell.dexText: Its craggy shell is mistaken for a boulder on mountain trails.

kobblet.name: Kobblet
kobblet.dexText: It rolls down hillsides and stacks itself with friends.

kobbrute.name: Kobbrute
kobbrute.dexText: It shoves boulders around to build walls for its family.

kolossar.name: Kolossar
kolossar.dexText: Some say mountains are just Kolossar that fell asleep.

leaplet.name: Leaplet
leaplet.dexText: It can leap twenty times its length in a single bound.

hopvault.name: Hopvault
hopvault.dexText: Its powerful legs launch it over treetops in one kick.

plumlet.name: Plumlet
plumlet.dexText: It puffs its plumage to look twice its size when startled.

plumehawk.name: Plumehawk
plumehawk.dexText: It patrols the hills in wide circles, eyes on the grass.

raptoreign.name: Raptoreign
raptoreign.dexText: It rules the high cliffs and dives on prey at blinding speed.

mirrakoi.name: Mirrakoi
mirrakoi.dexText: Its silver scales mirror the moon. Gazing at it brings calm.

mystrakoi.name: Mystrakoi
mystrakoi.dexText: It shows dreamers visions of distant shores in still water.

polarpup.name: Polarpup
polarpup.dexText: It slides belly-first over ice floes to chase fish.

morsicle.name: Morsicle
morsicle.dexText: It naps on drifting ice, its stubby tusks frosted white.

rimetusk.name: Rimetusk
rimetusk.dexText: Its tusks crack sea ice thick enough to hold a ship.

puffwyrm.name: Puffwyrm
puffwyrm.dexText: It hides inside drifting fog banks, sipping morning dew.

nimbusnake.name: Nimbusnake
nimbusnake.dexText: It coils through rain clouds, stirring up gentle storms.

quetzarion.name: Quetzarion
quetzarion.dexText: Its feathered coils trail rainbows across the storm clouds.

nuggit.name: Nuggit
nuggit.dexText: Flecks of ore glint in its body. Miners follow it for luck.

orecrag.name: Orecrag
orecrag.dexText: It rolls down mine shafts, gathering metal as it goes.

quarrox.name: Quarrox
quarrox.dexText: It crushes cliffs to feed on the iron veins within.

musklet.name: Musklet
musklet.dexText: It sprays a reeking mist and slips away while foes gag.

noxferret.name: Noxferret
noxferret.dexText: It hunts at night, leaving a toxic haze in its wake.

pallwick.name: Pallwick
pallwick.dexText: Its wick-flame burns pale blue when someone nearby is sad.

mournflare.name: Mournflare
mournflare.dexText: It drifts through graveyards, humming a mournful tune.

requiember.name: Requiember
requiember.dexText: It guides lost souls with a lantern-flame that never dies.

monkit.name: Monkit
monkit.dexText: It mimics the poses of mountain monks to train itself.

mantrill.name: Mantrill
mantrill.dexText: It chants before each bout, focusing its mind and fists.

mahasage.name: Mahasage
mahasage.dexText: It meditates under waterfalls, then strikes with focus.

ohmite.name: Ohmite
ohmite.dexText: It builds up static by scuttling over dry leaves.

pulsecarab.name: Pulsecarab
pulsecarab.dexText: Its shell hums with current that could light a village.

raylet.name: Raylet
raylet.dexText: It glides along the seafloor, crackling softly in the dark.

pulsaray.name: Pulsaray
pulsaray.dexText: One flap of its wide fins sends a shock across the bay.

rimeshade.name: Rimeshade
rimeshade.dexText: It drifts on snowy nights and leaves frost on windowpanes.

pilfur.name: Pilfur
pilfur.dexText: It sneaks into camps at night and steals shiny trinkets.

ransackle.name: Ransackle
ransackle.dexText: It hoards stolen loot in hollow trees and guards it fiercely.

rivetant.name: Rivetant
rivetant.dexText: Its body is plated like riveted metal. Colonies dig deep.

ramparant.name: Ramparant
ramparant.dexText: It walls off its colony with plates harder than steel.

ozlug.name: Ozlug
ozlug.dexText: Its bright frills warn predators that it tastes awful.

nudibrant.name: Nudibrant
nudibrant.dexText: Its vivid frills ripple as it oozes over reefs at dusk.

rambrawl.name: Rambrawl
rambrawl.dexText: It settles every quarrel by butting heads until one falls.

nimbolt.name: Nimbolt
nimbolt.dexText: It rides storm fronts and nests where lightning has struck.

omenkin.name: Omenkin
omenkin.dexText: It whispers names at dusk. Hearing yours is a bad omen.

omenwraith.name: Omenwraith
omenwraith.dexText: It wraps foes in shadow and feeds on their fear.

nipshell.name: Nipshell
nipshell.dexText: It hides in rock crevices, pinching anything that pokes in.

rocklobber.name: Rocklobber
rocklobber.dexText: Its stone claws can split boulders in one snap.

pyrefinch.name: Pyrefinch
pyrefinch.dexText: It sings at sunrise, and embers dance from its tail.

rubythrush.name: Rubythrush
rubythrush.dexText: Its burning song can be heard across the whole valley.

rimewing.name: Rimewing
rimewing.dexText: Frost crystals shed from its wings as it flutters past.

orrerion.name: Orrerion
orrerion.dexText: It is said to turn the stars along their paths each night.

scalekin.name: Scalekin
scalekin.dexText: It headbutts cliff walls, dreaming of the day it can fly.

wyrmscale.name: Wyrmscale
wyrmscale.dexText: Its body hardens into a shell as it waits to transform.

zarathorn.name: Zarathorn
zarathorn.dexText: Its crimson wings split storm clouds as it hunts.

tuskling.name: Tuskling
tuskling.dexText: It rolls across ice floes, giggling as it bumps along.

slushtusk.name: Slushtusk
slushtusk.dexText: It cracks thin ice with its tusks to fish below.

tundrusk.name: Tundrusk
tundrusk.dexText: A herd elder whose bellow can freeze a bay solid.

twirlfin.name: Twirlfin
twirlfin.dexText: It spins in circles until it makes itself dizzy.

whirlsage.name: Whirlsage
whirlsage.dexText: The whirlpools it stirs reveal hints of the future.

vortisage.name: Vortisage
vortisage.dexText: Sailors say its maelstrom eye sees across all seas.

somnulet.name: Somnulet
somnulet.dexText: It floats into bedrooms to nibble on sweet dreams.

slumbrace.name: Slumbrace
slumbrace.dexText: Its soft hug lulls even raging beasts to sleep.

velvedream.name: Velvedream
velvedream.dexText: It weaves dreams into a velvet cloak that it wears.

tinmole.name: Tinmole
tinmole.dexText: Its metal claws leave shiny tunnels under old mines.

spadeclaw.name: Spadeclaw
spadeclaw.dexText: It digs through bedrock as if it were soft clay.

vaultusk.name: Vaultusk
vaultusk.dexText: Its steel hide guards buried ore it hoards like treasure.

umbrat.name: Umbrat
umbrat.dexText: It steals shadows from lamps and hoards them in its nest.

sablemaw.name: Sablemaw
sablemaw.dexText: Half of its body fades into shadow when it stalks prey.

vespermaw.name: Vespermaw
vespermaw.dexText: At dusk its grin appears long before its body does.

sparquill.name: Sparquill
sparquill.dexText: When startled, its quills crackle and stand on end.

stormquill.name: Stormquill
stormquill.dexText: It rolls into a ball and charges through rainstorms.

thunderhog.name: Thunderhog
thunderhog.dexText: Each quill is a lightning rod. It calls down storms.

sootling.name: Sootling
sootling.dexText: It naps in warm ash and puffs sooty smoke when sneezing.

scorchnewt.name: Scorchnewt
scorchnewt.dexText: Its skin oozes a fuel that bursts into violet flame.

vulcandra.name: Vulcandra
vulcandra.dexText: It bathes in volcanic vents, breathing toxic fire.

sapfawn.name: Sapfawn
sapfawn.dexText: Sweet sap beads on its spots. Bees follow it everywhere.

stagbloom.name: Stagbloom
stagbloom.dexText: Flowers bloom on its antlers each spring, then fall.

willowhart.name: Willowhart
willowhart.dexText: Willow fronds hang from its antlers like a royal veil.

shalekid.name: Shalekid
shalekid.dexText: It hops between ledges no climber would dare to try.

talusram.name: Talusram
talusram.dexText: Its headbutts set off rockslides heard for miles.

stingrub.name: Stingrub
stingrub.dexText: It burrows in rotten logs, its stinger already sharp.

venomwing.name: Venomwing
venomwing.dexText: Its wings buzz so fast that it vanishes from sight.

tussler.name: Tussler
tussler.dexText: It challenges anything its size to a wrestling match.

warbrawler.name: Warbrawler
warbrawler.dexText: Its war cry echoes off the peaks before every bout.

yawnbruin.name: Yawnbruin
yawnbruin.dexText: It sleeps on mountain trails. Hikers walk around it.

xenolith.name: Xenolith
xenolith.dexText: A strange crystal stone that wanders the high ridges.

seepling.name: Seepling
seepling.dexText: It leaks from swamp mud and slurps up rotting leaves.

toxomire.name: Toxomire
toxomire.dexText: Its bog spreads wherever it rests. Plants wilt nearby.

thalassor.name: Thalassor
thalassor.dexText: Its awakening brings endless rain that swells the seas.

terrasolis.name: Terrasolis
terrasolis.dexText: Its stride parches rivers and raises new mountains.

zenithar.name: Zenithar
zenithar.dexText: It soars above the clouds to calm warring weather.

solvara.name: Solvara
solvara.dexText: It glows like a sunrise and shields the sick and weary.

velunox.name: Velunox
velunox.dexText: It drifts by moonlight, showing travelers lost paths.

starchime.name: Starchime
starchime.dexText: Its bell-like chime once a millennium grants a wish.
